findings.title: The plot card shows open and taken plots but not the waiting list the headline promises

location.description: the open plot 3 tile in the Elm Row plot card

findings.viewer_experience: A coordinator sees what a spreadsheet already shows, which plots are open, and does not see what is different about Plotwise: an open plot goes to the next person in line.

current.value: open and taken plots only, no person tied to plot 3 or 8

findings.target: plot 3 or 8 is tied to the person it is being offered to, in the same Elm Row example
findings.fix_direction: Tie plot 3 or 8 to the person it is being offered to. The maker must supply that person's details; do not invent them.

closed_when.check: in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports the plot card shows plot 3 or 8 tied to the person it is offered to

findings.title: The hollow Taken tiles read as empty plots

location.description: the hollow taken tile for plot 1 in the plot card

findings.viewer_experience: A coordinator who scans the card can read it as 10 plots free before checking the key, so the sample says the opposite of what it means. The key's hollow swatch looks like an unticked checkbox.

current.value: 10 taken tiles are white with an outline; 2 open tiles are solid green

findings.target: the tile that looks empty is the open one, or both states are labeled
findings.fix_direction: Keep the outline. Give taken tiles a quiet fill or a mark such as a small word or hatching, so that the tile that looks empty is the open one, or so that both states are labeled.

closed_when.check: in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports the taken tiles no longer read as empty slots at a glance, and the key swatches match

findings.title: The week and March lines still read as fixed rules

location.description: the Plot offers card text that says the grower has a week to say yes

findings.viewer_experience: A coordinator whose garden gives growers two weeks, or collects rent in April, may decide Plotwise does not fit.

current.value: "has a week to say yes" and "rent is due in March" are unqualified

findings.target: each line is marked as the example garden's setting or as a product rule
findings.fix_direction: Mark the lines as the example garden's settings or as the product's rules. The maker must say which is true.

closed_when.check: in the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports the Plot offers and Rent reminders lines say whether they are one garden's settings or product rules

findings.title: The headline lines end on "for" and "without", apart from their objects
findings.viewer_experience: The headline breaks inside its phrases, so it reads in pieces.

current.value: Run the waiting list for / your garden without / the spreadsheet

findings.fix_direction: Break at phrase boundaries, for example "Run the waiting list / for your garden / without the spreadsheet".

closed_when.check: in the desktop and widescreen viewports the headline lines break at phrase boundaries and no line ends on "for" or "without"
